data.name: Farwan
data.gender_notes: Farwan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'farara', which means to spread light or enlighten. A name for a boy signifying guidance and illumination. The name Farwan carries the meaning “Light or torch” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farwan usually hope their child will grow to embody light or torch and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Farwan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light or torch.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farwan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

In Islamic tradition, Farwan represents an individual with a robust personality and commendable attributes, making it a cherished name across various Muslim cultures.
